name: ARA4043
title: Binding node missing
summary: A data binding refers to a node that is not in the tree.
html:
A data binding refers to a node that is not in the tree.

#Common causes

  • The markup changed and dropped the bound element.

#Fixes

  • Re-create the binding after the mount that adds its node.

  • Code: ARA4043

  • Constant: ui::BINDING

  • Reported by: ara-ui
